Every endpoint the Express backend exposes (175), with its origin. Laravel API routes keep their contract (method, path, `?token=` / Bearer auth, response shape) and are traced to their contract tests in `API_MAPPING.md`. The `/api/panel/*` endpoints replace Laravel **web** routes (session + Blade) for the Next.js panel.
